amc12-2023a-q1.summary: Cities $A$ and $B$ are $45$ miles apart. Alicia leaves $A$ toward $B$ at $18$ mph while Beth simultaneously leaves $B$ toward $A$ at $12$ mph. How far from $A$ are they when they meet?
amc12-2023a-q1.summaryZh: 城市 $A,B$ 相距 $45$ 英里。Alicia 从 $A$ 出发以 $18$ 英里/小时驶向 $B$，Beth 同时从 $B$ 出发以 $12$ 英里/小时驶向 $A$。相遇点距 $A$ 多远？

methods.title: Use relative speed
steps: Their closing speed is $18+12=30$ mph, so the meeting time is $45/30=3/2$ hours.
Alicia travels $18\cdot(3/2)=27$ miles from $A$.
stepsZh: 两人的接近速度为 $18+12=30$ 英里/小时，因此相遇时间为 $45/30=3/2$ 小时。
Alicia 从 $A$ 出发的路程为 $18\cdot(3/2)=27$ 英里。

amc12-2023a-q2.summary: One third of a large pizza together with $3\tfrac12$ cups of orange slices weighs the same as three quarters of the pizza together with $\tfrac12$ cup of slices. Each cup of slices weighs $\tfrac14$ pound. Find the pizza's weight.
amc12-2023a-q2.summaryZh: 一个大披萨的 $\tfrac13$ 加 $3\tfrac12$ 杯橙子片，与该披萨的 $\tfrac34$ 加 $\tfrac12$ 杯橙子片同重。每杯橙子片重 $\tfrac14$ 磅。求披萨的重量。

methods.title: Set up a weight equation
steps: Let the pizza weigh $P$ pounds. The orange portions weigh $7/8$ and $1/8$ pounds.
stepsZh: 设披萨重 $P$ 磅，两份橙子片分别重 $7/8$ 磅和 $1/8$ 磅。

amc12-2023a-q3.summary: How many positive perfect squares less than $2023$ are divisible by $5$?
amc12-2023a-q3.summaryZh: 小于 $2023$ 且能被 $5$ 整除的正完全平方数有多少个？

methods.title: Count possible square roots
steps: A square divisible by $5$ has an integer square root divisible by $5$.
Because $44^2<2023<45^2$, the possible roots are $5,10,\ldots,40$, giving $8$ squares.
stepsZh: 平方数若能被 $5$ 整除，则其整数平方根也能被 $5$ 整除。

amc12-2023a-q4.summary: How many digits are in the base-ten representation of $8^5\cdot5^{10}\cdot15^5$?
amc12-2023a-q4.summaryZh: $8^5\cdot5^{10}\cdot15^5$ 的十进制表示共有多少位数字？

methods.title: Pair factors of 2 and 5
steps: This is $243$ followed by $15$ zeros, so it has $18$ digits.
stepsZh: 该数是 $243$ 后接 $15$ 个零，共有 $18$ 位。

amc12-2023a-q5.summary: Janet rolls a fair six-sided die four times and records the running total. Find the probability that the running total equals $3$ at some point.
amc12-2023a-q5.summaryZh: Janet 连续掷一枚公平六面骰子四次并记录累计点数。求累计点数曾经等于 $3$ 的概率。

methods.title: List the possible openings
steps: The total reaches $3$ only through one of the disjoint initial sequences $(3),(1,2),(2,1),(1,1,1)$.
Their probabilities sum to $1/6+1/36+1/36+1/216=49/216$.

amc12-2023a-q6.summary: Points $A$ and $B$ lie on $y=\log_2x$, and the midpoint of $\overline{AB}$ is $(6,2)$. Find the positive difference between their $x$-coordinates.
amc12-2023a-q6.summaryZh: 点 $A,B$ 位于曲线 $y=\log_2x$ 上，且 $\overline{AB}$ 的中点为 $(6,2)$。求两点横坐标之差的正值。

methods.title: Recover the sum and product
steps: Let the $x$-coordinates be $x_1,x_2$. The midpoint gives $x_1+x_2=12$ and $\log_2x_1+\log_2x_2=4$, so $x_1x_2=16$.

amc12-2023a-q7.summary: A date in 2023 is displayed as the eight digits YYYYMMDD. For how many valid dates does every decimal digit occur an even number of times?
amc12-2023a-q7.summaryZh: 2023 年的日期按八位数字 YYYYMMDD 显示。共有多少个合法日期使每个十进制数字均出现偶数次？

methods.title: Track digit parities
methods.titleZh: 追踪数字出现次数的奇偶性
steps: The year digits make the counts of $0$ and $3$ odd and that of $2$ even. Thus MMDD consists of one $0$, one $3$, and a repeated pair.
stepsZh: 年份数字使 $0,3$ 的次数为奇数而 $2$ 的次数为偶数，因此 MMDD 必由一个 $0$、一个 $3$ 和一对相同数字组成。

amc12-2023a-q8.summary: If Maureen scores $11$ on her next quiz, her mean rises by $1$. If she scores $11$ on each of her next three quizzes, her mean rises by $2$. Find her current mean.
amc12-2023a-q8.summaryZh: 若 Maureen 下一次测验得 $11$ 分，她目前的平均分提高 $1$；若接下来三次都得 $11$ 分，平均分提高 $2$。求目前平均分。

methods.title: Solve for the mean and count
methods.titleZh: 联立平均分与测验次数
steps: Let the current mean be $m$ across $n$ quizzes. The two conditions give $(mn+11)/(n+1)=m+1$ and $(mn+33)/(n+3)=m+2$.
These simplify to $m+n=10$ and $3m+2n=27$, so $m=7$.
stepsZh: 设目前 $n$ 次测验的平均分为 $m$。两种情况给出 $(mn+11)/(n+1)=m+1$ 和 $(mn+33)/(n+3)=m+2$。

amc12-2023a-q9.summary: A square of area $2$ is rotated inside a square of area $3$, with one inner vertex on each outer side. The four corner gaps are congruent right triangles. Find the ratio of a shorter leg to a longer leg.
amc12-2023a-q9.summaryZh: 面积为 $2$ 的正方形旋转后内接于面积为 $3$ 的正方形，内正方形每个顶点各落在外正方形一边上，四个角部空隙为全等直角三角形。求短直角边与长直角边之比。

methods.title: Use side sums and Pythagoras
methods.titleZh: 利用边长和与勾股定理
steps: Let the legs be $p<q$. Then $p+q=\sqrt3$ and $p^2+q^2=2$, so $2pq=1$.
Thus $p,q=(\sqrt3\mp1)/2$, and $p/q=(\sqrt3-1)/(\sqrt3+1)=2-\sqrt3$.
stepsZh: 设两直角边为 $p<q$。则 $p+q=\sqrt3$ 且 $p^2+q^2=2$，从而 $2pq=1$。

amc12-2023a-q10.summary: Positive real numbers $x,y$ satisfy $y^3=x^2$ and $(y-x)^2=4y^2$. Find $x+y$.

methods.title: Choose the sign using positivity
steps: From $(y-x)^2=4y^2$, $y-x=\pm2y$. The positive solution cannot have $x=-y$, so $x=3y$.
stepsZh: 由 $(y-x)^2=4y^2$ 得 $y-x=\pm2y$。正数条件排除 $x=-y$，故 $x=3y$。

amc12-2023a-q11.summary: Find the acute angle between two lines whose slopes are $2$ and $1/3$.
amc12-2023a-q11.summaryZh: 求斜率分别为 $2$ 与 $1/3$ 的两条直线所成的锐角。

methods.title: Use the angle-between-lines formula
steps: For the acute angle $\theta$, $\tan\theta=|(2-1/3)/(1+2/3)|=|(5/3)/(5/3)|=1$.
Hence $\theta=45^\circ$.

methods.title: Sum paired cube differences
steps: The $k$th pair is $(2k)^3-(2k-1)^3=12k^2-6k+1$, for $1\le k\le9$.

amc12-2023a-q13.summary: In a round-robin table-tennis tournament there are twice as many right-handed as left-handed players. Left-handed players win $40\%$ more games than right-handed players; there are no ties. Find the total number of games.
amc12-2023a-q13.summaryZh: 一次乒乓球循环赛中，右手选手人数是左手选手的两倍。左手选手赢得的场次数比右手选手多 $40\%$，且无平局。求比赛总场数。

methods.title: Combine integrality and a maximum bound
steps: Let there be $L$ left-handers and $2L$ right-handers. The win ratio $7:5$ forces the total number of games to be a multiple of $12$.
Left-handers can win at most $\binom L2+2L^2$ games, while they must win $7/12$ of $\binom{3L}2$; comparison gives $L\le3$.
For $L=1,2,3$, totals are $3,15,36$; only $36$ is a multiple of $12$, and it is attainable.
stepsZh: 设左手选手有 $L$ 人，右手选手有 $2L$ 人。胜场比为 $7:5$，故总场数必须是 $12$ 的倍数。
左手选手至多赢 $\binom L2+2L^2$ 场，而必须赢总场数 $\binom{3L}2$ 的 $7/12$；比较得 $L\le3$。

amc12-2023a-q14.summary: How many complex numbers $z$ satisfy $z^5=\overline z$?
amc12-2023a-q14.summaryZh: 有多少个复数 $z$ 满足 $z^5=\overline z$？

methods.title: Separate zero from unit-modulus roots
methods.titleZh: 分离零解与单位圆上的根
steps: Taking absolute values gives $|z|^5=|z|$, so either $z=0$ or $|z|=1$.
For $|z|=1$, multiply by $z$ to obtain $z^6=z\overline z=1$, giving six distinct roots. Including $0$ gives $7$.
stepsZh: 当 $|z|=1$ 时，两边乘 $z$ 得 $z^6=z\overline z=1$，有六个不同的根；再加零解，共 $7$ 个。

amc12-2023a-q15.summary: A zigzag path crosses a $100$-meter-long rectangular field. Every segment makes the same acute angle $\theta$ with a horizontal side, the total horizontal displacement is $100$ meters, and the total path length is $120$ meters. Find $\theta$.
amc12-2023a-q15.summaryZh: 一条折线路径横穿一个长为 $100$ 米的矩形场地。每段都与水平方向成同一锐角 $\theta$，总水平位移为 $100$ 米，路径总长为 $120$ 米。求 $\theta$。

methods.title: Add horizontal projections
steps: A segment of length $s$ contributes horizontal displacement $s\cos\theta$, regardless of whether it slopes upward or downward.
Adding all segments gives $120\cos\theta=100$, so $\cos\theta=5/6$ and $\theta=\arccos(5/6)$.
stepsZh: 长度为 $s$ 的一段无论向上还是向下，其水平位移均为 $s\cos\theta$。

amc12-2023a-q16.summary: Among complex numbers $z$ satisfying $|1+z+z^2|=4$, the maximum imaginary part is $\sqrt m/n$ in lowest terms. Find $m+n$.
amc12-2023a-q16.summaryZh: 复数 $z$ 满足 $|1+z+z^2|=4$。其虚部最大值既约写成 $\sqrt m/n$，求 $m+n$。

methods.title: Map the condition to a circle
steps: Put $w=z+1/2$ and $u=w^2$. Then $|u+3/4|=4$, so $u$ lies on the circle centered at $-3/4$ with radius $4$.
For $w=a+bi$, $b^2=(|u|-\operatorname{Re}u)/2$. On this circle, $|u|\le19/4$ and $\operatorname{Re}u\ge-19/4$, with equality simultaneously at $u=-19/4$.
Thus $b_{\max}=\sqrt{19}/2$, attained by $z=-1/2+i\sqrt{19}/2$. Hence $m+n=19+2=21$.
stepsZh: 若 $w=a+bi$，则 $b^2=(|u|-\operatorname{Re}u)/2$。圆上有 $|u|\le19/4$ 且 $\operatorname{Re}u\ge-19/4$，在 $u=-19/4$ 同时取等。
故最大虚部为 $\sqrt{19}/2$，可由 $z=-1/2+i\sqrt{19}/2$ 取得，因此 $m+n=21$。

amc12-2023a-q17.summary: Starting at $0$, Flora repeatedly jumps right by a positive integer $m$ with probability $2^{-m}$, independently at each jump. Find the probability that she eventually lands exactly at $10$.
amc12-2023a-q17.summaryZh: Flora 从数轴上的 $0$ 出发，每次独立地以概率 $2^{-m}$ 向右跳正整数距离 $m$。求她最终恰好落到 $10$ 的概率。

methods.title: Solve the hitting-probability recurrence
steps: Let $a_n$ be the probability of ever landing on $n$, with $a_0=1$. Conditioning on the first jump gives $a_n=\sum_{k=1}^n2^{-k}a_{n-k}$.
stepsZh: 设 $a_n$ 为最终落到 $n$ 的概率，且 $a_0=1$。按第一次跳跃分类得 $a_n=\sum_{k=1}^n2^{-k}a_{n-k}$。

amc12-2023a-q18.summary: Two unit circles have centers $O_1=(-1/4,0)$ and $O_2=(1/4,0)$. The largest circle inside and tangent to both is $C_3$. Another circle $C_4$, inside and tangent to both unit circles, is externally tangent to $C_3$. Find its radius.
amc12-2023a-q18.summaryZh: 两个单位圆圆心为 $O_1=(-1/4,0),O_2=(1/4,0)$。同时内切于两单位圆的最大内含圆为 $C_3$。圆 $C_4$ 也同时内切于两单位圆，并与 $C_3$ 外切。求其半径。

methods.title: Use symmetry and tangency distances
methods.titleZh: 利用对称性与相切距离
steps: By symmetry, $C_3$ is centered at the origin and has radius $3/4$.
Let $C_4$ have radius $r$ and center $(0,k)$. Tangency gives $k=3/4+r$ and $\sqrt{k^2+1/16}=1-r$.
stepsZh: 由对称性，$C_3$ 圆心在原点且半径为 $3/4$。
设 $C_4$ 半径为 $r$、圆心为 $(0,k)$。相切条件给出 $k=3/4+r$ 与 $\sqrt{k^2+1/16}=1-r$。

amc12-2023a-q19.summary: Find the product of all real solutions $x$ of $\log_{7x}2023\cdot\log_{289x}2023=\log_{2023x}2023$, subject to valid logarithm bases.
amc12-2023a-q19.summaryZh: 在各对数底数均合法的条件下，求方程 $\log_{7x}2023\cdot\log_{289x}2023=\log_{2023x}2023$ 的所有实数解 $x$ 的乘积。

methods.title: Make the logarithmic exponent quadratic
methods.titleZh: 化为对数指数的二次方程
steps: Change of base turns the equation into $1+t=(a+t)(b+t)$, hence $t^2+ab-1=0$. Its valid roots satisfy $t_1+t_2=0$.
stepsZh: 换底后方程为 $1+t=(a+t)(b+t)$，即 $t^2+ab-1=0$；两个合法根满足 $t_1+t_2=0$。

amc12-2023a-q20.summary: A triangular array starts with row $1$ equal to $[1]$. Row $n$ has $1$ at each end, and every interior entry is $1$ plus the sum of the two entries diagonally above it. Find the units digit of the sum of row $2023$.
amc12-2023a-q20.summaryZh: 一个三角形数阵的第 $1$ 行为 $[1]$。第 $n$ 行两端均为 $1$，每个内部数等于上一行斜上方两个数之和再加 $1$。求第 $2023$ 行所有数之和的个位数。

methods.title: Derive the row-sum recurrence
steps: If $S_n$ is the row sum, each earlier entry is counted twice and there are $n-2$ added ones, so $S_n=2S_{n-1}+n-2$ with $S_1=1$.
Induction gives $S_n=2^n-n$. Thus $S_{2023}=2^{2023}-2023$.
Because $2023\equiv3\pmod4$, $2^{2023}$ ends in $8$; subtracting the units digit $3$ gives $5$.
stepsZh: 设第 $n$ 行和为 $S_n$。上一行每个数被计算两次，另加 $n-2$ 个 $1$，故 $S_n=2S_{n-1}+n-2$，且 $S_1=1$。

amc12-2023a-q21.summary: For vertices $X,Y$ of a regular icosahedron, let $d(X,Y)$ be the fewest edges in a path joining them. Choose distinct vertices $Q,R,S$ uniformly. Find $P(d(Q,R)>d(R,S))$.
amc12-2023a-q21.summaryZh: 对正二十面体顶点 $X,Y$，定义 $d(X,Y)$ 为连接二者所需经过的最少棱数。等概率选取三个互不相同的顶点 $Q,R,S$，求 $P(d(Q,R)>d(R,S))$。

methods.title: Use distance layers and symmetry
methods.titleZh: 利用距离分层与对称性
steps: Fix $R$. Of the other $11$ vertices, $5$ are at distance $1$, $5$ at distance $2$, and one at distance $3$.
For ordered distinct $Q,S$, equality has probability $(5\cdot4+5\cdot4)/(11\cdot10)=4/11$.
Swapping $Q,S$ exchanges $>$ and $<$, so the required probability is $(1-4/11)/2=7/22$.
stepsZh: 固定 $R$。其余 $11$ 个顶点中，距离为 $1$ 的有 $5$ 个、为 $2$ 的有 $5$ 个、为 $3$ 的有 $1$ 个。
对不同的有序点 $Q,S$，两距离相等的概率为 $(5\cdot4+5\cdot4)/(11\cdot10)=4/11$。

amc12-2023a-q22.summary: A function $f$ on the positive integers is uniquely defined by $\sum_{d\mid n}d\,f(n/d)=1$ for every positive integer $n$. Find $f(2023)$.
amc12-2023a-q22.summaryZh: 正整数上的函数 $f$ 由条件 $\sum_{d\mid n}d\,f(n/d)=1$ 唯一确定。求 $f(2023)$。

methods.title: Use complementary divisors and subtraction
steps: Divide by $n$ and put $e=n/d$ to get $\sum_{e\mid n}f(e)/e=1/n$.
Since $2023=7\cdot17^2$, subtract the relations for $2023$ and $119$, and also those for $289$ and $17$. Subtracting the second difference from the first isolates $f(2023)/2023$.
stepsZh: 两边除以 $n$ 并令 $e=n/d$，得 $\sum_{e\mid n}f(e)/e=1/n$。
因 $2023=7\cdot17^2$，分别将 $2023$ 与 $119$ 的关系作差、$289$ 与 $17$ 的关系作差，再以第一差减第二差，即可孤立 $f(2023)/2023$。

amc12-2023a-q23.summary: How many ordered pairs of positive real numbers $(a,b)$ satisfy $(1+2a)(2+2b)(2a+b)=32ab$?
amc12-2023a-q23.summaryZh: 有多少个正实数有序对 $(a,b)$ 满足 $(1+2a)(2+2b)(2a+b)=32ab$？

methods.title: Force equality in three AM-GM bounds
methods.titleZh: 同时满足三个均值不等式的等号条件
steps: AM-GM gives $1+2a\ge2\sqrt{2a}$, $2+2b\ge4\sqrt b$, and $2a+b\ge2\sqrt{2ab}$. Multiplication gives the left side at least $32ab$.
Equality in the given equation requires equality in all three bounds: $1=2a$, $2=2b$, and $2a=b$.
These are simultaneously satisfied only by $(a,b)=(1/2,1)$, so there is one ordered pair.
stepsZh: 均值不等式给出 $1+2a\ge2\sqrt{2a}$、$2+2b\ge4\sqrt b$、$2a+b\ge2\sqrt{2ab}$；相乘得左边不小于 $32ab$。
题中等式成立要求三个不等式同时取等，即 $1=2a$、$2=2b$、$2a=b$。
三式仅由 $(a,b)=(1/2,1)$ 同时满足，故只有一个有序对。

amc12-2023a-q24.summary: For a fixed $1\le n\le10$, let $A_1\subseteq A_2\subseteq\cdots\subseteq A_n$ be subsets of $\{1,2,\ldots,10\}$. Let $K$ count all such chains over all allowable $n$. Find the remainder when $K$ is divided by $10$.
amc12-2023a-q24.summaryZh: 对某个 $1\le n\le10$，设 $A_1\subseteq A_2\subseteq\cdots\subseteq A_n$ 均为 $\{1,2,\ldots,10\}$ 的子集。令 $K$ 为所有允许的 $n$ 下这类子集链的总数。求 $K$ 除以 $10$ 的余数。

methods.title: Choose each element's entry time
methods.titleZh: 选择每个元素首次进入的时刻
steps: For fixed $n$, each of the ten elements independently chooses its first set among $A_1,\ldots,A_n$, or never appears. Hence there are $(n+1)^{10}$ chains.
Their sum is $45\equiv5\pmod{10}$.
stepsZh: 固定 $n$。十个元素各自独立选择首次进入 $A_1,\ldots,A_n$ 的时刻，或始终不出现，因此共有 $(n+1)^{10}$ 条链。

amc12-2023a-q25.summaryZh: 整数 $a_1,\ldots,a_{2023}$ 满足 $\tan(2023x)=\dfrac{a_1\tan x+a_3\tan^3x+\cdots+a_{2023}\tan^{2023}x}{1+a_2\tan^2x+\cdots+a_{2022}\tan^{2022}x}$（在有定义处成立）。求 $a_{2023}$。

methods.title: Read the top term from De Moivre's expansion
methods.titleZh: 从棣莫弗展开读取最高次项
steps: Expand $(\cos x+i\sin x)^{2023}=\cos(2023x)+i\sin(2023x)$ and divide its imaginary and real parts by $\cos^{2023}x$.
The numerator coefficient of $\tan^{2023}x$ comes from the all-sine term and equals $i^{2023}/i=(-1)^{(2023-1)/2}$.
stepsZh: 展开 $(\cos x+i\sin x)^{2023}=\cos(2023x)+i\sin(2023x)$，再将虚部与实部分别除以 $\cos^{2023}x$。
